title: The release's phone-test gate is only ever tested with runs that passed
what: The gate's own test feeds it only successful phone runs. A cancelled, failed or still-running run is never put in front of it, so nothing proves such a run is refused.
expected: The gate test also hands it a cancelled and a failed run of the right name on the right commit and checks the release stays blocked.
fix_line: Add cancelled and failed runs to the gate test and check they never open the gate

title: Nothing tests that the 'skip the phone test' switch is ignored on a real release
what: The gate test always pretends to be a branch push with the skip switch off. The rule that the skip switch works only for a hand-started dry run, never for a release tag, is never exercised.
expected: A test runs the gate as a tag push with the skip switch on and checks the gate still demands the phone runs.
fix_line: Add a gate test for a tag push with the skip switch on

title: A Play dry run is never tested to change nothing
what: Both Play scripts have a dry run that should only ask Play to validate and then throw the change away. No test checks that a dry run never commits, that a hand start defaults to dry run, or that a wrong tag stops before any upload.
expected: A test with a stand-in Play checks a dry run validates and discards, and a bad tag is refused before any download or upload.
fix_line: Test the dry run and bad-tag paths of both Play scripts against a stand-in Play

title: The store-picture order check is never tested to stop a wrong order going live
what: The listing run should throw the change away when Play reports the pictures in a different order than uploaded. The test only checks that pictures can be named back; the stop-and-discard path is never run.
expected: A test feeds a wrong order back and checks the change is discarded and nothing is committed.
fix_line: Add a test where Play reports the wrong order and nothing is committed

title: The release run's safety stops are never tested
what: The release must stop when the tag and app version differ, when signing secrets are half set, and must never publish when the update proof fails. These are written in the release workflow but no test checks any of them, so a later edit could drop one unnoticed.
expected: A test reads the release workflow and checks the version stop, the half-signing stop, and that publish waits on both build and update proof.
fix_line: Add a workflow-text test for the release's stops and job order

title: The Razorpay check's guards against a live key are never tested
what: The Razorpay check refuses a key that is not a test key and never prints the key. Nothing tests either guard, so a change could let a live key through or print it in the public log.
expected: A small test runs the check with a live-looking key and with no keys and checks it refuses or skips before any call and never prints the key.
fix_line: Add a test for the live-key refusal and the hidden key

title: The two WhatsApp runs have no test at all, including the 'never print the token' promise
what: The WhatsApp probe and set-up runs send real messages, register the number and copy the token into the server. No test checks the number guard, the missing-secret stops, or that the token, PIN and owner's number never reach the public log.
expected: A test reads both runs and checks every secret is masked and each guard stops before a send.
how_often: every WhatsApp set-up or probe run
fix_line: Add a workflow-text test for the WhatsApp runs' guards and masking

title: The cross-role journey runner's pass and fail rules are never tested
what: The release needs the cross-role journeys green, but nothing tests the runner itself: that a failed step stops the journey, that later steps are marked skipped, that the run turns red, or that fresh gyms are made each run.
expected: A small test drives the runner with a made-up failing step and checks FAILED, SKIPPED, a red result and the failed-step picture.
fix_line: Add a runner test with one failing step

title: Four hand-run picture, video and phone-condition runs have no test
what: The exercise-clip run, the store-picture run, the watch demo video run and the phone-conditions run have no test of their own: not the key list, the old-APK reuse, the empty-video guard, or which test gym is used.
expected: Each run's plan step and guards have a small self-test like the Play scripts have.
fix_line: Add a small self-test for each run's plan and guard steps

title: The outage alert is never tested for an issue closed by hand or a changed list
what: The outage test covers open, stay quiet and close. It never closes the issue by hand while a part is down to check a new one opens, and never checks the retitle and 'What is down changed.' comment.
expected: The test closes the issue by hand mid-outage and checks a new issue, and checks the comment when the list changes.
fix_line: Add the hand-closed and changed-list cases to the outage test

title: The two ratchets on every push have no test
what: The silent-catch count and the bare-scroll-check count are meant to never rise. Neither ratchet script has a test, so nothing proves a new silent catch or a new bare check turns the push red.
expected: A test adds one silent catch and one bare check to a copy and checks each ratchet fails.
fix_line: Add a failing-case test for each ratchet

title: The release gate's own tests run only on release day
what: The self-tests for the phone gate, the shard check and the release checks run only when a release starts. The iPhone parity self-test runs on push but inside a warn-only step, so its failure never turns a push red. A break is found only when the owner is trying to release.
expected: Every push runs all the release self-tests in a step that can fail.
fix_line: Run all release self-tests on every push, outside the warn-only step

title: The database job's failure path is never tested
what: The database runner should print FAIL and the last 20 lines for a failing test file and turn the job red, and the function-body lint should stop later steps. Nothing tests the runner or the lint with a broken file.
expected: A test runs the runner with one failing file and checks the FAIL line and the red result.
how_often: every push with a database change
fix_line: Add a broken-file case for the database runner and the lint

title: The watch build run's cancel, re-run and keep-pictures rules are never tested
what: The watch build should keep pictures when a test fails, let one watch's failure not cancel the others, cancel an older push run but never a hand start, and re-run against the same watch APK. None of this is tested.
expected: A workflow-text test checks the upload-always, fail-fast-off and cancel rules.
fix_line: Add a workflow-text test for the watch build's cancel and upload rules
